text:
dylan: FYI we observed intermittent TLS handshakes failing for edge LB in ap-southeast-1 around 08:47 UTC. Some clients saw TLS alerts and then client retries caused cross-region spillover.

aisha: Any cert rotation happening?

dylan: No cert rotations. Traces show alpha-backends returning early FINs and we saw a sharp rise in TLS session renegotiations.

peter: Immediate actions: 1) disable TLS session reuse for that LB pool (owner: peter, ETA: 1h) 2) increase backend socket backlog to reduce early FINs (owner: aisha, ETA: 4h) 3) apply temp routing cap to limit burst traffic from mobile clients (owner: dylan, ETA: 2h)

infra-bot: Created INC-20418. Subscribers: dylan, aisha, peter.

oncall: Can we add an automated check for sudden jump in TLS renegotiations?

aisha: I'll add a dashboard for TLS handshake errors + session reuse rate and an alert if reuse rate drops below 30% while handshake_failures > 50 in 5m. Owner: aisha, ETA: 6h.

dylan: Postmortem follow-ups: - instrument LB to capture TLS renegotiation stacks - run a chaos test with flaky TLS on a staging backend - review client SDKS for aggressive reconnect behavior

peter: I'll own the chaos test (owner: peter, ETA: next Thu). aisha: can you handle the LB instrumentation work?

aisha: Yup. I'll push metrics and sample logs to INC-20418.

oncall: Let's also consider a longer-term solution: implement connection draining heuristics and smarter failover that waits for retry windows to cool. Add to backlog?

dylan: Add it. Owner: dylan, ETA: next Sprint planning.

peter: I'll drop a short blameless summary in INC-20418 after we validate the fixes.

dylan: Thanks. 09:30 UTC sync tomorrow to check alert results.
